dedupe_keys.name: serie storica verbali per infrazioni del codice della strada

description: Lecce publishes a historical series of reports for road-code violations. The native package lists seven CSV views and a spreadsheet workbook. Distribution labels identify restricted-traffic zones, red-light violations, street checks, local police, immediate contestation, driver-document cases and traffic assistants. These describe road-transport enforcement; they do not establish traffic demand, road capacity or network connectivity. Actual report counts, event dates, persons, vehicle details and completeness were not read. The exact CSV endpoint and native title bind this package to the existing national-catalogue record. The municipal source establishes Lecce as publisher and coverage, correcting the earlier generic regional attribution. The licence is CC BY 4.0. Metadata and distribution links are public, but current file access, later-use costs and service operation remain separately unverified. No specific simulation method, related model or platform is identified.
